text:
ana: Quick sync — Datadog just confirmed they'd like to co-announce a "trace + curated dashboard" bundle on GCP Marketplace. Want to align on assets & runbook this week.
matt: Awesome. Do we have a target launch date from them?
lucy: They mentioned mid-next-month in the call but said dates are flexible depending on approvals.
nana: (typo) sorry — ana: mid-Apr  — they need marketing assets and a short tech runbook from us by Apr 7.
omar: Tech runbook = install steps + sample traces + dashboard import JSON, right?
ev an: evan: yes, and a lightweight example app + OTEL collector config. Keep it tiny for onboarding.
matt: I'll own the dashboard JSON and a short walkthrough. Need Datadog contact for dashboard review (Priya)?
lucy: Priya@datadog confirmed review. She asked for our recommended tags and span conventions.
omar: Here's a starter otel config we can share:```yaml
receivers:
  otlp:
    protocols:
      grpc: {}
exporters:
  datadog:
    api:
      key: "<REDACTED>"
service:
  pipelines:
    traces:
      receivers: [otlp]
      exporters: [datadog]
```
ev an: Add note: use our trace attributes for routing: redwood.customer_id and redwood.model_id.
nana: ana: Marketing needs a 2-line blurb + 1 screenshot by Apr 9. Who can take screenshots?
matt: I can export a sample dashboard screenshot Thurs. Also will add small GIF for social.
lucy: Legal flagged the marketplace listing copy — I can loop in legal and partner ops.
ev an: We should include tracking tags in the marketplace listing for install funnels. Tag suggestions: rdw_partner=datadog, rdw_channel=marketplace.
datadog-partner-bot: Reminder: joint-playbook-template.pdf uploaded to partner workspace: https://drive.datadog/rdw-playbook 
omar: If we need a joint blog, what's the owner? Marketing or Partnerships?
lucy: Partnerships will draft, marketing will finalize. Draft by Apr 10 for review.
matt: Quick checklist I propose: 1) runbook + otel config (dev) 2) dashboard JSON + screenshot 3) marketplace listing copy 4) PR/bl og draft 5) partner legal signoff 6) launch tracking links
ana: ana: Can everyone add ETA to that checklist by EOD tomorrow? I'll consolidate and send to Priya.
ev an: I'll add the install sample app + small readme.
datadog-partner-bot: FYI — Datadog partner PM scheduled a check-in Mon 10am PT. Calendar invite sent.
matt: Perfect — see you on Mon. Anything else?
lucy: One more: confirm that the dashboard uses our model latency + token-cost panels so customers see cost impact.
omar: noted. I'll wire up sample metrics and a small synthetic trace generator for demo.
nana: ana: thanks all — will create the runbook thread and assign tasks. Priya is our reviewer from Datadog. :thumbsup:
